mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn can cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong consumer demand, which can boost economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.5 million and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with weak growth
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and GDPC1 growth < 2% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -1% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is growing faster than the GDP (GDPC1), it signals a supply-driven economy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth > GDPC1 growth and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
